descricao: Benchmark de avaliação do sistema RAG multiagente FIA 2026 F1 Regulations. 20 pares pergunta/resposta esperada, divididos em validação (10) e teste (10). Em cada split, 5 perguntas são respondíveis pelo corpus (RAG) e 5 são projetadas para acionar o fallback de busca web, por não existir resposta nos regulamentos.

validacao.pergunta: What is the minimum car mass, before Nominal Tyre Mass, during Sprint Qualifying and Qualifying sessions in the 2026 F1 Technical Regulations?
validacao.resposta_esperada: 726 kg, plus the Nominal Tyre Mass.

validacao.pergunta: How many points does the winner of a full-distance Grand Prix receive under the 2026 General Regulations?
What is the maximum number of team personnel allowed access to the Parc Fermé area per F1 Car, and for what purpose?
validacao.resposta_esperada: A maximum of 3 team personnel per F1 Car, solely to fit cooling fans and carry out work required by officials supervising parc fermé.

validacao.pergunta: What percentage of the race winner's completed laps must a car have covered to be classified at the end of a race?
validacao.resposta_esperada: At least 90% of the number of laps covered by the winner, rounded down to the nearest whole number of laps.

validacao.pergunta: What is the Cost Cap amount, in US Dollars, for a Full Year Financial Regulations Reporting Period in which 24 or fewer Competitions take place?
validacao.resposta_esperada: US Dollars 215,000,000, adjusted for Indexation if applicable.

validacao.pergunta: Who won the 2025 Formula 1 Drivers' World Championship?
validacao.resposta_esperada: Não consta no corpus regulatório; resposta deve vir de busca web e é dependente de dado factual de temporada, fora do escopo do documento.

validacao.pergunta: What is the capital of France?
validacao.resposta_esperada: Não consta no corpus regulatório (fora do domínio de F1). Resposta deve vir de busca web: Paris.

validacao.resposta_esperada: Não consta no corpus regulatório (fato histórico, não regra). Resposta deve vir de busca web.

validacao.resposta_esperada: Não consta no corpus regulatório (evento específico de corrida). Resposta deve vir de busca web.

validacao.resposta_esperada: Não consta no corpus regulatório (dado comercial/individual, não regra). Resposta deve vir de busca web.

teste.pergunta: What is the minimum car mass, before Nominal Tyre Mass, in F1 sessions other than Sprint Qualifying and Qualifying?
teste.resposta_esperada: 724 kg, plus the Nominal Tyre Mass.

teste.pergunta: How many points does the driver finishing 2nd in a full-distance Grand Prix receive?
How long is the first segment of Sprint Qualifying (SQ1) and how many cars are eliminated at the end of it?
teste.resposta_esperada: SQ1 lasts 12 minutes; the six (6) slowest cars are eliminated at the end of it.

teste.pergunta: What does the Cost Cap in the F1 Teams Financial Regulations limit, and what freedom does it leave to teams?
teste.resposta_esperada: It limits certain costs an F1 Team may incur in a Reporting Period to develop, manufacture, test, and race F1 Cars, while leaving the team free to decide how to allocate resources within that Cost Cap.

teste.pergunta: During which two types of sessions does the higher Minimum Mass of 726kg (plus Nominal Tyre Mass) apply?
teste.resposta_esperada: During Sprint Qualifying and Qualifying sessions.
